prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence remains thin for most individual change types as only adoption new_flow has been tested more than once.
Adoption new_flow and sign_in hint are the only change types with significant wins so far.
Predictions were consistently too high across all round 1 tests compared to noise-corrected results.
Predictions were frequently too high overall, but were underestimated for home new_flow, choose_path layout, and sign_in hint.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: +1.6% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- choose_path, copy: +0.3% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, layout: +1.8% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, layout: -0.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: +0.8% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, new_flow: +2.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, wait_info: -0.3% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, hint: +3.8% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, incentive: -3.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: -1.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 76.0%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 63.3%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s

Changes:
0: [adoption, new_flow] Guided Pet Preset Style Choice Flow: Adds a guided style preset step before photo upload to let users choose pre-rendered pet aesthetics and prevent generation errors. (why: Support receives tickets about custom pet generation failures (3 emails) and adoption step conversion drops to 63.3%.)
1: [home, redesign] Stage Layout Desktop Spawn Progress Screen: Redesigns the waiting screen using a stage layout with real-time generation progress and desktop rendering instructions. (why: The waiting step has a long mean duration of 2336s and 18.7% dropoff, while support reports pets failing to show on desktop.)
2: [finish, new_screen] Interactive Pet Controls Overview Screen: Inserts a dedicated onboarding screen showing how to summon, hide, and right-click the desktop pet before launching. (why: Finish step drops to 64.8% and support receives recurring tickets regarding confusion on controlling, hiding, or talking to pets.)
3: [sign_in, hint] Account Pet Sync Restoration Hint: Adds explicit hint text under sign-in options explaining how existing pet profiles are automatically restored. (why: 8 support emails were received about missing or reset pets after signing in again.)
4: [choose_path, copy] Fast Desktop Setup Story Copy: Updates story headline and body text to emphasize that onboarding takes under 60 seconds to complete. (why: Choose path screen has a high mean time of 514s despite an 8s median.)
5: [home, wait_info] Pet Rendering Time Estimate Indicator: Displays progress indicator and estimated remaining time on the waiting screen during pet rendering. (why: Home waiting step median is 201s and mean is 2336s, causing user drop-off.)
6: [home, notification] Background Rendering Readiness Notification: Adds a desktop notification option on the waiting screen so users are alerted as soon as their pet spawns. (why: Mean waiting time is 2336s (nearly 39 minutes), indicating users switch tasks while waiting.)
7: [adoption, layout] Split Layout Adoption Certificate Confirmation: Changes adoption_certificate layout to a split view displaying pet details alongside the official stamp. (why: Adoption step has the lowest conversion rate (63.3%) among early setup steps.)
8: [finish, incentive] System Tray Quick Control Hint: Adds a helpful hint on home_intro explaining how to access desktop pet controls via the system tray icon. (why: 3 support emails report post-onboarding confusion regarding how to control, hide, or talk to their pet.)

scores.note: Proven win for adoption new_flow (+1.6% average). Strong support tickets and low step conversion justify major flow addition.
Home new_flow showed +2.0% lift previously; waiting step duration is extreme and desktop render issues are reported.
Finish new_screen yielded +0.8% in earlier testing. High finish dropoff and support tickets confirm demand for control overview.
Sign_in hint had a strong +3.8% lift in round 1 and addresses 8 support tickets with minimal implementation cost.
Choose_path copy change showed modest +0.3% lift. Easy text change but evidence from tickets is lacking.
Wait_info on home step previously resulted in a slight negative lift (-0.3%). Low confidence despite long wait times.
Addresses severe mean wait time (2336s), but notification system requires OS permission flow and native integration.
Adoption step has lowest overall step conversion (63.3%), though layout changes across other steps have shown mixed results.
Low cost hint addresses post-onboarding confusion tickets, leverage strong past performance of hint-type interventions.
